title: An alternating form space on an n-dimensional vector space over any field has an s-dimensional common isotropic subspace or surjects onto all alternating forms on a t-dimensional subspace when n is at least s times t to the fourth power
author: Youming Qiao
difficulty_reason: Ordinary prerequisites are finite-dimensional linear algebra, radicals and simultaneous congruence operations over an arbitrary field. The remaining authored construction first obtains a large minimum-degree restriction, then isolates successive alternating pivot pairs in reverse order and performs a tube-fibre induction that confines every collateral change to an unused independent tail. Maintaining that simultaneous independence is a nonroutine new construction above ordinary qualification problems; conservative H1, with all four stages retained.

proof_review.note: Original Theorem 1.1, arbitrary field, $s,t\geq2$, $n\geq st^4$: an $s$-dimensional common zero restriction or a $t$-dimensional full alternating-form restriction. Complete definitions, all four full original proof stages, matrices and tube-fibre independence closure retained. Ordinary prerequisites: basic finite-dimensional linear algebra and alternating forms; Weaver [Wea17] and Sims [Sims65, Section 2] supply credited inspiration, with no unexpanded theorem substituted for the local proof. Reference to original Section 5.8 in the terminology footnote points to the retained complete PDF, and its original value is restored in the wrapper. Literal source quirks retained: Step 1 closing says totally-isotropic for the forthcoming complete-space branch; Step 2 closing uses $t+1$ amid $t^\prime+1$ notation; Step 3 contains $\Lambda(s+2i-1,\F)$; Step 4 labels its nonadjacent fibres with $j\leq t$ and later switches $s/t$ in one displayed list. These exact formulas and all adjacent constructions are preserved as source material, with no proof vote, counterexample test or mathematical correction. Equivalent map/group/Grassmannian consequences and helpers count zero. Full current page/formula/glyph QA complete; actual stable fresh compile passes and exhaustive diagnostics retained.
